evidence_cards.content: The system will capture the details of voucher sales between MISU sales team and Distributors. During the distribution the system will capture the following details: Name of the distributor*, Name of the Sales Man*, Date of distribution*, No of vouchers sold*. According to the number of vouchers required by the distributor, the system should allocate the relevant vouchers with their numbers and batch numbers based on the stock. Invoice amount = No of vouchers x Wholesale price. Mode of payment is Cash.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the core interaction sequence for capturing voucher sales/distribution data, which includes user-provided inputs (distributor name, salesman name, date, quantity) and system responses (voucher allocation, invoice calculation). This constitutes a main flow for a related use case (recording voucher sales), though not specifically for 'Create and Print a Voucher Batch'.

evidence_cards.content: The mandatory information required during a distribution transaction is mentioned below: Name of the distributor (Selecting from Distributor Master), Name of the Sales Man (Selecting from Sales man master), Date of Distribution (Date selection option), Required Qty (No of vouchers sold (Allow only Numeric Entry)), Invoice Amount = Whole Sale Rate (should taken from settings master based on sale date) * Qty Sold. (Automatic Calculation). The system will generate an auto-generated number as Distribution Invoice No.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the step-by-step user actions (selecting from masters, entering numeric quantity) and system responses (automatic calculation, auto-generation of invoice number) for a distribution transaction. Again, this pertains to recording sales, not creating/printing batches.

evidence_cards.content: Suppose the distributor or salesman name is not available in the system, then the system has a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen and enter the new Distributor and Salesman details, without closing the present screen.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow or exception handling mechanism within the distribution process, allowing users to add missing master data without leaving the current transaction screen.
